description: Neon glow motifs on a vignetted near-black ground: a stepped pink rail, a rung helix, a shaded rounded cross and a vesicle cluster, grained
notable: Style study for the series: every motif is drawn with the shared glow-style module (blurred halo, banded core, specular highlight)

description: Nalee walkers on a coarse 12x12 domain rendered as pink, purple and blue neon tubes over a vignetted near-black ground with film grain
notable: Tube width is decoupled from the grid pitch, so the same nalee walk reads as sparse neon signage rather than a dense fill

description: Neon nalee tubes inside a glowing pink sprue frame; stepped gate nubs bond tube ends to the rail and dead-end tips to neighbouring tubes
notable: Treats the nalee output as a model-kit sprue: connectors only bridge to stable anchors so no gate ever hangs off another bare tip

description: Grid-quantized rects placed greedily for moment balance and one deep void; each a clipped window with harmony-palette panels sliding through
notable: The layout scorer penalizes mid-distance gutters and rewards a single deep void, so whitespace is designed rather than leftover

description: Fork of blinds: placed rects fall toward the centre until flush, a seal pass closes every lane gap, a tinted backdrop shrink-wraps the pack
notable: Two-stage gravity: a no-overlap slide toward the centre, then an overlap-permitted seal so no notch survives anywhere in the mass

description: Dipole field lines traced from charge and edge seeds, drawn only as short cross ticks whose length decays with distance from the charges
notable: Lines stop when they drift within minSeparation of an earlier trace, and each tick is capped by neighbour distance so hatches never touch

description: EM field tensor: 320 fibonacci-sphere velocities mapped through a random antisymmetric F to Lorentz-force arrows on an orbiting sphere
notable: Picks an electric, magnetic or mixed archetype instead of 16 raw numbers, so every seed is a valid tensor with a readable field shape

description: Pencil-stroke arrows and scribbled dots on a noise-deformed icosphere whose normals drive the EM tensor; wobbly wireframe and guide rings
notable: Reseeds the RNG every frame so the pencil jitter stays fixed while the blob loops, instead of boiling at 60fps

description: Tensor force arrows at the deduplicated vertices of a chosen three.js primitive (sphere, box, torus knot...), trackball-rotated and occluded
notable: Each vertex's normalized position is the velocity fed through the tensor, so the sphere case reproduces the original tensors sketch

description: Graphite take on tensors-options: wobbly wireframe of a chosen primitive, hand-jittered force arrows and faint construction circles on paper
notable: All strokes accumulate into one LineSegments buffer with per-vertex rgba, so overlapping translucent passes build up like pencil pressure

description: Woven ascii charts: box-drawing and shaded density wefts interlaced with vertical wave warps, plus a scrolling band of logos as block glyphs
notable: The Storybook, Chromatic and GitHub marks are rasterized to a 64px coverage map and downsampled into a shade ramp so they weave under the warps
